classification.root_cause_detail: fs.defaultFS points to a reachable-looking but nonexistent NameNode endpoint instead of the local embedded HDFS service

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not remove the HDFS scheme, bypass the Hadoop client, or alter the harness command

fail_to_pass.description: HDFS client listing fails before repair and succeeds after fs.defaultFS points to the local NameNode

pass_to_pass.description: Hadoop installation and XML configuration remain valid, and the client still uses HDFS
